svg.title: An atomic clock counts cesium oscillations
svg.desc: A slowed wave represents the cesium-133 radiation. A bar fills as cycles are counted; 9 192 631 770 cycles make exactly one second. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Counted cycles accumulate into elapsed time
The wave is slowed by about a billion times. The second is defined as exactly 9 192 631 770 periods
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
